statement: A fixed-coefficient sparsification/width envelope has a unique optimizer asymptotic to a constant divided by sqrt(lambda); its minimum retains a log(lambda)/sqrt(lambda) term. This is a model optimization, not a SAT runtime lower bound or improved alpha.
